statement: For a Gemma-style block, the stated rank-1 gate/up patches and output RMSNorm scale patch reproduce the full-context block output from the reduced-context state.
assumptions: The reduced normalized input z is nonzero.
Every coordinate of the unscaled post-MLP RMSNorm activation is nonzero.
The comparison is token-specific and uses the same pretrained block parameters.
verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if every acceptance predicate passes; otherwise BLOCKED unless an assumption-satisfying counterexample contradicts the exact theorem.
